name: mission-control
description: Keeps tasks, agents, a step timeline and artifacts in a pane and band beside the chat.

autoOpen.title: Open at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Mission Control pane when a session starts.

guide.title: Guide Claude
guide.description: Add the Mission Control update tool and one system-prompt section so Claude keeps the panel current.

look.title: Look
look.description: How the pane and band are drawn: rich (pictures where the terminal can draw them) or text (letters and box lines only, for a terminal whose glyphs render badly, or a screen reader). Applies at once.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Raise a native notification when Claude has waited on you for 20 seconds (waits), also when a turn over 60 seconds finishes (done), also when a turn fails (all), or never (off).

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Add a COST row with the session's dollar cost to the budget view. Off by default: Mission Control otherwise draws no dollar figure.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: The editor o: open runs as <editor> -r -g <path>:<line> (VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf read this). When it cannot run, the path is copied instead.

doneSound.title: Done sound
doneSound.description: Also play a short sound when the done notification is raised (a main turn over 60 seconds ended). macOS only; off by default.

agentLimitMin.title: Agent time limit (minutes)
agentLimitMin.description: A subagent still working after this many minutes is flagged once as a long run in NEEDS YOU. It only reports; it never stops an agent. 0 turns it off.

turnLimitMin.title: Turn time limit (minutes)
turnLimitMin.description: A main turn still running after this many minutes is flagged once as a long run in NEEDS YOU. 0 turns it off.
